recombination.rule: d_adv + d_ch + d_imp - d_full is recombined cell by cell for every substep; the frozen update is exactly the sum of the three recorded ingredients up to floating point

wall.rule: every face whose frozen aperture is exactly zero carries exactly zero advective and zero chemical-potential flux, which is how n.grad(mu) = 0 and the impermeability of the solid are imposed; no separate wall flux exists
